user_intent.original_question: 查询电视剧系列评分衰退最严重的 Top 10。即找出电视剧系列（TV series）中，后续季（season）相比第一季评分下降幅度最大的前 10 个系列，需要计算每个系列第一季与后续季的平均评分差值（衰退幅度），按衰退幅度降序排列取前 10。

business_rules.name: 评分可信度
business_rules.condition: 排名类查询建议加 num_votes > 10000 过滤

business_rules.name: NULL处理
business_rules.condition: average_rating IS NOT NULL, season_number IS NOT NULL

historical_qa_pairs.original_question: 电视剧系列评分趋势分析，分析电视剧各季评分变化趋势，计算评分衰退率
historical_qa_pairs.sql: WITH season_ratings AS (SELECT s.id AS series_id, s.primary_title AS series_title, e.season_number, ROUND(AVG(ep.average_rating), 2) AS season_avg_rating, COUNT(DISTINCT e.id) AS episode_count FROM titles s JOIN episodes e ON s.id = e.parent_id JOIN titles ep ON e.id = ep.id WHERE s.title_type = 'tvSeries' AND ep.average_rating IS NOT NULL AND e.season_number IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s.id, s.primary_title, e.season_number) ...

knowledge.content: titles (series) ←→ episodes ←→ titles (episode)，episodes.parent_id = series.id 且 episodes.id = episode.id
Decline Rate = (S1_avg_rating - S_last_avg_rating) / S1_avg_rating，> 30% 为严重衰退
排名类查询应加 num_votes > 10000 过滤
